note: The interaction track's increase threshold is its target times one minus
the hysteresis band, so at the default 16 ms target an increase needs an
estimate below 12.8 ms. The estimate is driven by the displayed frame
interval, which vsync quantises to a 16.6 ms floor on a 60 Hz display, so
the increase branch cannot be reached while a hand is moving and quality
only ever ratchets down. These raise the target past that floor: 24 ms
puts the threshold at 19.2 ms, one quantum of headroom, and 33 ms puts it
at 26.4 ms, where only a genuinely late frame prevents a climb.
